text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors noted issues related to food quality and wait times at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. While the overall rating remains high with no critical reviews, comments about food appeared most frequently, followed by concerns about wait times. Service and atmosphere were mentioned less often but still appeared in the feedback. The library should consider reviewing these areas to maintain visitor satisfaction.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days show consistent concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was backed up and only grab-and-go options were offered late in the day. Many found the food quality disappointing, describing items as bland, poorly prepared, or overpriced for the portion sizes. There were also comments about the narrow menu choices and dissatisfaction with the café’s pricing and service logistics. Other aspects of the visit, such as atmosphere, received fewer mentions and less criticism.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service delays and long wait times were also noted, particularly when the kitchen was backed up and only grab-and-go options were available late in the day. While some visitors appreciated aspects of the library itself, the food and dining experience consistently drew criticism and may require operational review.
